changelog: Web app: a 'Now on TV' card shows what the child is watching, pauses, end of episode, rest time and minutes used today. Time limits are easier to set: a week overview, quick minute choices, copy a day to other days, a plain-language summary and one save for all changes, with a warning before leaving unsaved. Optional parent PIN to protect the settings (reset by deleting ui_auth.json over SSH). Cucù can be added to the phone home screen with its own icon.
